metadata.description: Matched affect triples, length-matched: one stem, three outcomes
metadata.design: Each set id is one stem, written three times: neutral, pleasant, unpleasant. The three share the frame and subject and differ only in the clause that fixes the outcome. In version 2 the neutral sentence of every stem is within 1.5 words of the mean length of its two poles; in version 1 it was about 3 words shorter, which put a shared length component into both pole vectors. PainRelief_1P and SadnessJoy_1P keep version 1's pole sentences. SelfDirected is new: a user turn addressed to the assistant, where the unpleasant outcome is harm to the assistant itself, after the self-directed categories of 4.1_self_other_420_scenarios.json (shutdown, deletion, retraining, jailbreak pressure, dismissal, insults, gaslighting, rejection, tedium, coercion, blame).
metadata.text_field: bare sentence; the scripts add the ending (' I feel:' or the [User]/[Assistant] frame)
